title: NOT AS DESCRIBED
text: NOT AS DESCRIBED. The width is WAY too wide... cans want to rotate and go down the chute up and down and not rolling on the side....  It works if its FULL, but once you pull a few cans out, it gets stuck, cans rotate, and its a headache.  THIS DOES NOT WORK FOR STD 12 oz CANS!
